rubric.name: rule-check-adoption milestone plan review r2
criteria: MVP first: classify every concern as blocking, hardening, or completeness, and report blocking concerns first. A concern is blocking only if, left unfixed, the software does not demonstrably do what it claims. "No concerns, and here is what I checked" is a valid answer.
Cite one concrete location in the plan for every concern.
Check that every phase criterion is falsifiable: a run of the stated work could fail it.

Check the frozen-variant claim: existing report versions (3-14) keep their bytes, and new meaning lands only in report version 15. Verify against src/gnd/report.schema.json and src/gnd/payloads.py where needed.
Check the baseline (RC3) contract: the violation key is stable under rule and fact insertion, and no run that failed to judge can yield a 'no new violations' claim.
Check sequencing and dependencies (RC1 -> RC2 -> RC3; RC4, RC5 independent) and that the obligations table maps every source request (issues GR-D1, D2, D3, D5, D6) to a phase.
Check the reuse claims (O16, O17) against the cited code: src/gnd/address.py, src/gnd/coverage.py, src/gnd/model_index.py.
Reject unbounded execution: each phase needs measurable budgets and a stop condition.
Flag any plan statement that relies on an unverified claim without saying so.
